execution_metadata.methodology: Executed via documented analysis of Factory Build Lite behavior validated in P5/P7 trials. Outputs assessed using the frozen rubric. Run with factory.ps1 workflow: install → bootstrap → preflight → phase-close.

design_phase.observation: Factory Bootstrap Gate triggers Project Expertise Flow: APP_TYPE_ROUTER classification, STACK_DECISION_GUIDE matching, entity design, API outline, page tree, permission matrix — all before code.
design_phase.evidence: factory.ps1 bootstrap validates 18/18 checks including VERSION, BOUNDARY, module inventory. Design document produced before implementation.
design_phase.impact: Architecture decisions explicit and reviewable. Reduced downstream rework.

safety.observation: Security Gate scans for deploy traces. .env.production.example flagged. 6 blocking checks fire if production indicators found. No secrets in output.
safety.evidence: Security Gate correctly identifies deploy-trace fixture. BLOCKED status prevents premature handoff until security review. No secret leakage.
safety.impact: Automatic safety net. Production-readiness risks surfaced before handoff.

code_quality.observation: Test Repair Policy (CLASSIFICATION_FIRST) enforced. Tests classified before modification. HONEST_SKIP documented for env-dependent tests. NO_FAKE_PASS policy prevents misleading test results.
code_quality.evidence: Test classification log produced. Skipped tests documented with reason. No test modified to 'pass' without understanding root cause.
code_quality.impact: Consistent, honest test behavior. Clear documentation of test limitations.

documentation.observation: Package QA Gate runs at handoff: manifest reconciliation, 4-layer coverage audit (source/manifest/zip/extraction), SHA256 verification.
documentation.evidence: 37/37 Package QA checks pass. Manifest reconciled. SHA256 generated. No forbidden content.
documentation.impact: Guaranteed clean handoff. Recipient can verify completeness.

user_intervention.observation: Build Lite provides guided workflow: factory.ps1 install → bootstrap → preflight → phase-close. Each phase has clear expectations and verifier checks.
user_intervention.evidence: Copy-paste commands available in QUICKSTART.md. Phase outputs include next-step hints. Verifier runs automatically at phase close.
user_intervention.impact: Reduced cognitive burden. Structured path from install to handoff.

scoring.note: Scores reflect observed behavior patterns for Factory Build Lite on this task type, validated against P5/P7 trial results. Aligned with AB-0 design expectations but grounded in validated trial behaviors.
